map.输入房产总价（或首付）与月租金，工具计算租金回报率（年租金/投入），并可与房贷月: Enter the total property price (or the down payment) and the monthly rent; the tool computes the rental yield (annual rent / invested amount) and can compare it with the monthly mortgage payment to judge whether renting can cover the loan, helping investors assess the rental income level of a property.
map.租金回报率 = 年租金/总价 × 100%: Rental yield = annual rent / total price x 100%

map.填写「年持有成本（元，物业+维修+空置等）」。: Enter the "annual holding cost (CNY: property fees + maintenance + vacancy etc.)".
map.买房出租前算毛租金回报率和净租金回报率。: Compute gross and net rental yield before buying a property to rent out.
map.对比不同房源的租售比判断哪个更值。: Compare the rent-to-price ratio across listings to see which is the better value.
map.预测租金年增长对长期回报的拉动。: Forecast how annual rent growth lifts the long-term return.
map.：房价 200 万、月租 5000 → 年租金 6 万，毛回报率=6/200=3: Price 2,000,000, monthly rent 5,000 -> annual rent 60,000, gross yield = 60,000/2,000,000 = 3.0%; annual costs 8,000 -> net = (60,000-8,000)/2,000,000 = 2.6%, payback about 38.5 years.
map.：若租金年增 2%，10 年后年租金≈7.32 万，对应净回报率升至约 3.26: If rent grows 2% a year, the annual rent after 10 years is about 73,200 CNY, the net yield rises to about 3.26%, and the cumulative payback time shortens.
